_note: Emissions factor sets for the dashboard Emissions page. Each factor set declares which axis its factors are keyed on; the loader resolves that axis onto the dashboard's common ESTO product/flow axes using leap_mappings outputs. Add a new entry and point active_factor_set at it to switch factor sources; nothing else in the dashboard needs to change.

mapping_sources._note: Paths are resolved against the leap_mappings repository root (LEAP_MAPPINGS_ROOT, default ../leap_mappings). leap_mappings owns these mappings; the dashboard only reads them.

factor_sets.label: 9th edition CO2e emissions factors (energy-weighted)
factor_sets.source_note: 9th edition energy-weighted CO2e factors by fuel/subfuel, 2025-04-03 extract.

ninth_fuel_axis._note: The factor file is keyed on fuels + subfuels. Rows are collapsed to one 9th-edition fuel code: any subfuel other than the placeholder replaces its parent fuel. A parent row whose subfuel is the placeholder stands in for that fuel's '<fuel>_unallocated' 9th code, but only when no explicit unallocated subfuel row already supplies it - otherwise the parent row is a pure fuel-level aggregate and is dropped so its members are not double counted.

esto_product_factor_overrides._note: Energy-sector totals exclude biogenic CO2 to match IPCC inventory reporting. The positive source factors remain available for separately reported biomass-combustion memo estimates; these overrides affect only the dashboard total. Industrial waste and non-renewable municipal waste retain their source factors.
